method: Whole text reads of xattr implementation/header, Git blob and SHA256 verified.
findings: read_hash requires configured xattr use, nonempty checksum/mtime attributes and floating-point mtime comparison within MTIME_TOL. No fresh content digest, ctime, size or inode binding is checked in this function. Same-size rewritten file with restored mtime is therefore not ruled out by this admission guard. End-to-end control still needed.

Checksum text syntax/algorithm-specific length and complete finite timestamp parse are not validated here; strtod ignores end pointer. Caller contract and FLOAT_SIGN_DIFF macro need checking before malformed timestamp outcome claims.
write_hash stores checksum and mtime as two separate path-based xattr writes using previously collected file mtime. No transactional pair or fresh content check in this function.
rm_xattr_list can return NULL on list/read failure; is_deduplicated and mark_deduplicated pass map to hash-table iterator without a local NULL guard. Runtime consequences not reproduced.
Dedup-state routines mutate keys already owned by GHashTable from .mtime to .cksum/.dedup during iteration. Stored key hash/equality invariants need focused control.
Linux no-follow fallback follows links when HAVE_LXATTR is unavailable; Apple and BSD wrappers have explicit no-follow calls.
BSD setter maps all nonnegative written lengths to success without checking full requested count; fixed-size listing/value buffers have no resize retry.
limits: Static source audit only; no physical xattr or upstream end-to-end runtime tests.
Own cache/mutation regressions exist from earlier work; not freshly run or broadened here.
Native pHash deferred; global full repository count remains150/500.
